notes.title: Patch 1.01 - Easier cave, Windowed Mode, Partial Gamepad Support, etc
notes.content:
-Added a quit button to the main menu
-Added a How-to-play button to the game menu.
-Added partial controller support
-Reduced the rate at which your torch runs out in the cave
-Added windowed mode and other display options
-Various bug fixes

Rebind keys in the in-game options menu, keys can be set to gamepad.

Full controller support coming soon
